ai_summary: Bajaj Healthcare Limited reported strong Q2 FY27 results, with revenue up 18.9% YoY and Profit after Tax increasing 26.9% YoY, largely driven by an 82% surge in formulations and 28.5% growth in API exports. Key impacts include the successful launch of a new anti-seizure medication, a credit rating upgrade, and approval for the GenRx acquisition, signalling strategic expansion and improved financial health. A potential red flag is the 6.1% YoY and 22.4% sequential decline in domestic API sales for the quarter, alongside a slight year-over-year contraction in gross and EBITDA margins.
